title: bias-audit-report template variables
description: Values for templates/bias-audit-report.md.j2 and templates/bias-audit-report.html.j2. Generated by tpl-jinja from bias-audit-report.md; `description` on each property is the question put to the author.

attr_1.title: Attr 1
attr_1.description: Which protected attribute is audited on the first row - the group variable, named as the data labels it?

attr_2.title: Attr 2
attr_2.description: Which protected attribute is audited on the second row?

audit_date.title: Audit date
audit_date.description: On what date was this audit run, as YYYY-MM-DD? The date the numbers were computed, not the date the report was written up.

auditor.title: Auditor
auditor.description: Who ran this audit and signs the report? One named human, and under ISO 42001 someone who is not the model's own owner.

bootstrap_n.title: Bootstrap n
bootstrap_n.description: How many bootstrap resamples produced the confidence intervals above? Too few and the intervals are decoration.

di_ci_high_1.title: Di ci high 1
di_ci_high_1.description: What is the upper bound of the 95% confidence interval on that disparate-impact ratio?

di_ci_low_1.title: Di ci low 1
di_ci_low_1.description: What is the lower bound of the 95% confidence interval on that disparate-impact ratio?

di_ratio_1.title: Di ratio 1
di_ratio_1.description: What disparate-impact ratio was measured for the first attribute?

di_threshold.title: Di threshold
di_threshold.description: What disparate-impact ratio is the floor here? The four-fifths rule puts it at 0.8 unless you have a written reason to move it.

dp_ci_high_1.title: Dp ci high 1
dp_ci_high_1.description: What is the upper bound of the 95% confidence interval on that first demographic-parity difference? An interval crossing the threshold is not a pass.

dp_ci_high_2.title: Dp ci high 2
dp_ci_high_2.description: What is the upper bound of the 95% confidence interval on that second demographic-parity difference?

dp_ci_low_1.title: Dp ci low 1
dp_ci_low_1.description: What is the lower bound of the 95% confidence interval on that first demographic-parity difference?

dp_ci_low_2.title: Dp ci low 2
dp_ci_low_2.description: What is the lower bound of the 95% confidence interval on that second demographic-parity difference?

dp_diff_1.title: Dp diff 1
dp_diff_1.description: What demographic-parity difference was measured for the first attribute?

dp_diff_2.title: Dp diff 2
dp_diff_2.description: What demographic-parity difference was measured for the second attribute?

dp_threshold.title: Dp threshold
dp_threshold.description: What demographic-parity difference is the largest you will accept before the result counts as a failure? Set it before you look at the numbers.

eo_ci_high_1.title: Eo ci high 1
eo_ci_high_1.description: What is the upper bound of the 95% confidence interval on that equalised-odds difference?

eo_ci_low_1.title: Eo ci low 1
eo_ci_low_1.description: What is the lower bound of the 95% confidence interval on that equalised-odds difference?

eo_diff_1.title: Eo diff 1
eo_diff_1.description: What equalised-odds difference was measured for the first attribute?

eo_threshold.title: Eo threshold
eo_threshold.description: What equalised-odds difference is the largest you will accept before the result counts as a failure?

model_version.title: Model version
model_version.description: Which exact model version was under test? An audit that names a model family attests to nothing after the next silent provider update.

result_1.title: Result 1
result_1.description: Did the first attribute clear the demographic-parity threshold, interval included?

result_2.title: Result 2
result_2.description: Did the second attribute clear the demographic-parity threshold, interval included?

result_di_1.title: Result di 1
result_di_1.description: Did the first attribute clear the disparate-impact floor, interval included?

result_eo_1.title: Result eo 1
result_eo_1.description: Did the first attribute clear the equalised-odds threshold, interval included?

sample_size.description: How many examples are in that validation set? Every confidence interval below is a function of this number, and a small one makes a passing result meaningless.

stratification_notes.title: Stratification notes
stratification_notes.description: What did you have to do to keep live personal data out of this audit, and what did that cost in representativeness? This sentence is what a GDPR reviewer reads first.

stratification_strategy.title: Stratification strategy
stratification_strategy.description: How was the set stratified across the protected attributes? Say what was balanced and what was left to chance; unstated stratification is how a group ends up with four rows.

system_name.description: Which named system was audited - the one a regulator could find in your service catalogue? Not the model, the system that puts the model in front of people.

validation_set_id.title: Validation set id
validation_set_id.description: Which validation set produced these numbers? Name a pinned, retrievable id - an audit whose set cannot be re-pulled cannot be re-run by anyone who doubts it.
